title: Efficacy of Pembrolizumab in Advanced Melanoma
description: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind study evaluating the long-term efficacy and safety of Pembrolizumab compared to standard chemotherapy in patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma.

title: Novel ACE Inhibitor for Treatment-Resistant Hypertension
description: This study aims to assess the dose-response relationship and tolerability of a novel ACE inhibitor (TVA-204) in patients who have failed to achieve blood pressure control on at least three other antihypertensive medications.
primaryEndpoint: Reduction in seated systolic blood pressure from baseline to week 12

title: Gene Therapy Approach for Early-Onset Alzheimer's
description: A first-in-human trial testing the safety of a viral vector-based gene therapy (AAV-Neuro9) designed to enhance amyloid clearance in patients with early-onset familial Alzheimer's disease.
primaryEndpoint: Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) over 6 months

title: Biologic Therapy for Severe Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: A post-marketing surveillance study to monitor the long-term safety profile and real-world effectiveness of subcutaneous biologic therapy in adults with severe rheumatoid arthritis.
primaryEndpoint: Rate of serious opportunistic infections over a 2-year period

title: CAR-T Cell Therapy in Relapsed B-Cell Lymphoma
description: Evaluating the objective response rate of a next-generation CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy in patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL).
primaryEndpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) according to Lugano criteria

title: Wearable Monitor for Atrial Fibrillation Detection
description: A decentralized clinical trial comparing the diagnostic accuracy of a novel continuously recording wearable biosensor versus standard Holter monitoring for detecting silent atrial fibrillation.
primaryEndpoint: Sensitivity and specificity of AF detection over 14 days

title: Monoclonal Antibody for Multiple Sclerosis
description: A randomized, active-controlled trial assessing whether a novel monoclonal antibody can slow disability progression more effectively than standard interferon therapy in relapsing-remitting MS.
primaryEndpoint: Proportion of patients with 6-month confirmed disability progression

title: Oral JAK Inhibitor for Ulcerative Colitis
description: Evaluating the efficacy and safety of a selective oral JAK-1 inhibitor in patients with moderate to severe ulcerative colitis. The study was paused pending review of a safety signal.
primaryEndpoint: Clinical remission at week 8 defined by Mayo score
